Reviewer, two passes. `t` untouched in every unit; joined `t` equals the packet text; gloss covers all 164 novel forms; `__broaden__` entries are old entry whole + ' · ' + new reading (checked by script). Units are numbered from 0 as in units.json (and as the notes cite them).

### Pass 1 — the known issue
ለበሓውርትኒ (unit 22): l said 'regions-our-also' and i 'our lands ... our cities'. The form ends in the enclitic -ኒ 'also' only; 'our' would be -ነ (as in ለደቂቅነሂ, unit 21, where it is real). Removed 'our' from l and from i (both nouns), and rewrote the note to say there is no pronoun. (?) on 'lands' kept: በሓውርት is read from the plural pattern, not confirmed.

### Pass 1 — findings refused, with reasons
- Unit 0, ኀበ 'where' as a title-phrase: the note already says the reading is loose and flags it (?); published ch. 53 treats the heading the same way.
- Unit 0 'see unit 40' and the other 'unit N' cross-references (units 3, 7, 9, 40): checked, each points to the right unit in the 0-based numbering; kept.
- Unit 0, the Menelik = David statement: matches the published known entry for ዳዊት (the young prince styled David); kept.
- Unit 2, አምላከ 'God-of' as a construct after a vocative: sound; gloss calls it accusative/construct.
- Unit 4, ክብር rendered 'honor' (units 4, 7) but 'glory' (unit 36): both are inside the house range 'glory, honour' (known entry); not changed.
- Unit 6, l 'if he-loved-us' beside i 'if he loves us': ለእመ + perfect is an open conditional; i is fair. 'as he loved Israel' supplies an elided verb; acceptable.
- Unit 6, ይትዔየሮ / ይግእዞ readings: cannot be improved without Dillmann at hand; left with (?) (now in l and i too).
- Unit 7, እምኀቤሁ 'from him': fine.
- Unit 16, አውግር 'hills' (?): plural not confirmable; the note already says so; kept.
- Unit 21 and 25, ሰብእ 'man' in l / 'people' in i: ሰብእ is collective, note says so; kept.
- Unit 30, l 'over-us' for ለነ: this is the broadened reading; kept.
- Unit 32, ኢትትአንተሊ and ኢትትሀየዪ: unverifiable stems, honestly flagged (?) in l, i and note; kept.
- Unit 36, ዖዳ 'went around her' and the 2 Samuel 6:14 link: reading marked 'mine' in the note; published ch. 49–50 reads ዖደ the same way; kept.
- Unit 36, ስርጉት as the feminine of a participle ስሩግ: cannot be checked; no change.
- Unit 40, ጴጥሮስ ወዮሐንስ at Tabor and the Luke 9:33 cross-reference: correct as the note states it.
- Unit 22: did not remove the (?) on 'lands' (see above).
- Scripture parallels in the notes (units 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 19, 20, 33, 35, 36): all checked to be real passages; kept.
- Not touched, outside the two files: known-forms.json has some loose entries (ያሤኒ 'he make good', የሐንጽ 'he build', ሕጉ '+ -u'); they belong to published parts.

Pass-1 revisions carried into the gloss: ተሣህሎ (no suffix), ጽዋዐ/ወጽዋዐ (construct), ይርሕቁ (intransitive), በላዕሌነ ('over us'), ወበከሐክኒ ('parched ground'), ታረስዖ/ወታአብዶ (doubling suffix), በታዕካኒ and ወበፅሙናኒ (uncertainty restated). ለበሓውርትኒ's entry already had no 'our' and was left alone.

### Pass 2 — findings refused, with reasons
- ይክል lemma ከህለ (Dillmann's spelling may be ክህለ): cannot verify the vowel; kept.
- ወይመቊስ lemma መቈሰ, ይግእዞ lemma ገአዘ, ወኢታድኅፅነ lemma አድኅፀ, ኢትትአንተሊ lemma ተአንተለ, ወኢትትሀየዪ lemma ተሀየየ, ይትዔየሮ lemma ተዔየረ: all are conjectural lemmas inferred from the forms and all carry (?) in meaning and grammar; nothing better is available without the lexicon, so they stay as honestly flagged.
- ወመሐሪ, መሐኪ: left (?); the irregular spelling is already stated in the entry.
- ስርጉት lemma ስሩግ (from ሰርገወ): not verifiable; kept.
- ነያ lemma ናሁ: matches the published ናሁ entries.
- ወአንከርዎ 'causative-type stem': loose but not wrong; kept.
- ሀብነ 'imperative ሀብ': correct; the masculine-form point is in the unit note, not repeated in the gloss.
- ምርሐነ: already says 2ms with (?).
- ይሰባሕ lemma ሰብሐ with (?): the passive stem is uncertain; kept.
- ኍሉቅ as its own lemma: an adjective/participle, acceptable as in ብሩህ.
